name: form-5471-workpaper
description: Populates a Form 5471 master workbook from client documents, entirely in the browser.

scripts.build: node -e "console.log('CI-safe build: dist/ is committed as reviewed (session fixes live in dist, not yet in src \u2014 see PROJECT-NOTES.md). Skipping rebuild so Pages deploys the reviewed app. Use npm run build:full after porting fixes to src.')"
scripts.start: npm run build && npx --yes serve dist
scripts.test:all: npm run test:rules && npm run test:spaces && npm run test:layer
scripts.build:full: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-server.mjs && node scripts/inject-layer.mjs
